If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.

## Walkthrough This PR updates indirect and a few direct Go module versions across four go.mod files (root `go.mod`, `metis/go.mod`, `providers/go.mod`, `test/e2e/go.mod`): bumps include `google.golang.org/grpc`, `google.golang.org/protobuf`, `google.golang.org/genproto` revisions, `golang.org/x/oauth2`, `cel.dev/expr`, `cloud.google.com/go/compute/metadata`, `go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp`, `github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2`, and `github.com/moby/spdystream`. No source code, API signatures, or exported declarations changed. ## Changes **Go module dependency updates** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Top-level indirect updates**
`go.mod`|Advanced several indirect dependencies in the root `go.mod`, including `golang.org/x/oauth2` (v0.30.0 → v0.34.0), `cel.dev/expr` (v0.24.0 → v0.25.1), `cloud.google.com/go/compute/metadata` (v0.6.0 → v0.9.0), `google.golang.org/genproto/googleapis/api` and `.../rpc` (moved to `v0.0.0-20251202230838-ff82c1b0f217`), `go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp` (v1.5.0 → v1.7.1), and others; no module/toolchain/replace/go directives changed.| |**metis module bumps**
`metis/go.mod`|Updated `google.golang.org/grpc` from v1.72.2 → v1.79.3 and `google.golang.org/protobuf` from v1.36.8 → v1.36.10; `genproto/googleapis/rpc` advanced to the same newer pseudo-version.| |**providers module bumps**
`providers/go.mod`|Bumped `golang.org/x/oauth2` to v0.34.0, `cloud.google.com/go/compute/metadata` to v0.9.0, and advanced `google.golang.org/*` (grpc, protobuf, genproto) revisions; `go` and `toolchain` directives retained.| |**e2e test module indirects**
`test/e2e/go.mod`|Updated multiple indirects used by tests: `cel.dev/expr` → v0.25.1, `github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2` → v2.27.1, `github.com/moby/spdystream` → v0.5.1, `go.opentelemetry.io/proto/otlp` → v1.7.1, `golang.org/x/oauth2` → v0.34.0, and `google.golang.org/*` modules to newer revisions.| |**Scope confirmation**
`go.mod`, `metis/go.mod`, `providers/go.mod`, `test/e2e/go.mod`|All edits are version bumps in go.mod files only; no source file, exported API, or behavioral changes were introduced.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 12
✅ Passed checks (12 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | This PR only updates Go module dependencies. No Ginkgo test files or test definitions were modified, making this check not applicable. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | Custom check for Ginkgo test code is not applicable. PR only modifies Go module dependencies (go.mod files). Tests in repo use standard Go testing package, not Ginkgo BDD framework. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo e2e tests are added in this PR. Changes consist only of go.mod dependency version updates. The check is not applicable. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR only updates Go module dependencies in go.mod files, not new Ginkgo e2e tests. The SNO Test Compatibility check applies only when new Ginkgo tests are added, making it not applicable here. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PR is a pure dependency update (vendor dependencies for spdy and grpc CVE fixes). No deployment manifests, operator code, or controllers with scheduling constraints were added or modified. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR only updates go.mod/go.sum dependency versions with no Go source code changes. Test suite (suite_test.go) is unchanged and properly configured. No new stdout writes to process-level code detected. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | New test/e2e tests use net.JoinHostPort() correctly and obtain IPs dynamically. No hardcoded IPv4 addresses or external connectivity requirements found. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly references upgrading spdystream and grpc to fix CVEs, which aligns with the primary changes shown in the raw summary—dependency version bumps for google.golang.org/grpc, google.golang.org/protobuf, and github.com/moby/spdystream across multiple go.mod files to address security vulnerabilities. |
✏️ Tip: You can configure your own custom pre-merge checks in the settings.
✨ Finishing Touches
